# Lynette Lee Eng
Candidate for Los Altos District 2
I am former Mayor Lynette Lee Eng, and I humbly ask for your vote for Los Altos City Council, District 2.
After two terms on the City Council, eleven years as a Park Commissioner, and two terms on the Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury, I’ve always believed in listening first and leading with integrity. Serving our community has been the honor of my life, and I will never take your trust for granted.
I initiated the Grant Park Senior Program because our seniors deserve a community that cares for them.
I was instrumental in the Los Altos Summer Concert Series to bring neighbors together and strengthen our community.
I support thoughtful growth that respects our community, provides adequate infrastructure, and preserves the character of our neighborhoods. I will work to ensure transparent government, responsible stewardship of community assets, and strong local decision-making.
I will continue to serve every member of our community, not special interests, with integrity, experience, and steady leadership.
Together, we can keep Los Altos financially strong, beautiful and a welcoming place that everyone is proud to call home.
# Sierra Club Endorses Lynette
The Sierra Club has endorsed your candidacy for Los Altos’s City Council, District 2 The Loma Prieta Chapter is proud to support your campaign in recognition of your demonstrated commitment to protecting our environment and advancing clean energy solutions.
The Sierra Club is dedicated to electing leaders who share our values, especially environmental protection. Since our founding in 1892, we have worked to protect wild places, safeguard public health, and ensure that every community enjoys clean air, safe water, and a healthy environment.
# Endorse Lynette Lee Eng
### for City Council District 2
We welcome YOUR endorsement of Lynette Lee Eng for Los Altos City Council District 2.
You may write your endorsement statement below or, if you would like to make your statement more personal, you can schedule a Zoom meeting with us and we will record your statement on video. # Sierra Club Endorses Lynette Lee Eng
“The Sierra Club has endorsed your candidacy for Los Altos’s City Council, District 2 The Loma Prieta Chapter is proud to support your campaign in recognition of your demonstrated commitment to protecting our environment and advancing clean energy solutions.
The Sierra Club is dedicated to electing leaders who share our values, especially environmental protection. Since our founding in 1892, we have worked to protect wild places, safeguard public health, and ensure that every community enjoys clean air, safe water, and a healthy environment.”
# Americans 4 Hindus Endorse Lynette Lee Eng
“Americans4Hindus proudly endorses LYNETTE LEE ENG in her campaign for Los Altos City Council, District 2, in the November 3, 2026 General Municipal Election.
Lynette Lee Eng brings extensive experience in local government, community service, and civic leadership. A former Los Altos Mayor and City Councilmember, she also served for many years on the Los Altos Parks and Recreation Commission. Her public service has emphasized transparency, responsible financial management, preservation of community resources, and the character and quality of life of Los Altos.”

## Testimonials
Lynette Lee Eng will be ready to get to work from day one if elected.
I proudly give Lynette my full support because I have seen her consistently live up to her campaign message of advocating for government transparency and accountability. Through her actions, she has challenged city staff when necessary, asked important questions, and worked to ensure that the government remains accountable to the people it serves.
Just as importantly, Lynette treats the people of Los Altos with respect. She believes in inclusion, listens to different perspectives, and actively seeks public input before making decisions that affect our community.
Lynette is not tied to political parties or special interests. Her commitment is to Los Altos and, most importantly, to its people. She brings independence, integrity, and a willingness to ask the tough questions while keeping the interests of the community at the center of her work.
That is why I am proud to support Lynette Lee Eng.
Lydia Kou
former Mayor, City of Palo Alto
I strongly endorse Lynette Lee Eng. She's tenacious, hard-working, and tough-minded.
Bill Evers, former member (representing Los Altos), Santa Clara County School Board; former U.S. Assistant Secretary of Education
"Lynette is active at the Community / Senior Center. She always has the Los Altos residents’ interest in mind."
Carol Wong
I am proud to endorse Lynette Lee Eng for Los Altos City Council. At a time when Los Altos needs experienced leadership that resists special interests and advocates for transparent local decision-making, Lynette Lee Eng is absolutely the right choice.
Dr. Diana Blum
Neurologist
“Lynette is the most helpful person “
Tena Trabookis
“Lynette Lee Eng’s dedication to our community is evident in the time, energy, and heart she brings to everything she does. She doesn’t simply show up—she listens, does the hard work, and follows through. Her passion for serving others, protecting what makes Los Altos special, and making thoughtful decisions for the future is what makes her such a committed and trusted community leader.”
Allyson Rosen
"Both as a former City Council member and a volunteer, Lynette has been a strong advocate for public safety and the support of our senior residents. As a resident of Los Altos volunteering to help seniors prepare for difficult situations, I appreciate her continuing engagement.
Art Whipple,
CERT and ham radio operator."
